newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK five-year notes avg accepted yield 7.23 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK five-year notes avg accepted yield 7.23 pct.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Monday the average accepted price of the five-year Exchange Fund notes tendered today was 100.89 yielding 7.23 percent versus 7.49 percent at a previous tender in June.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue totalled HK$2.23 billion versus HK$1.83 billion at the last tender.
The lowest accepted yield was 7.24 percent while the average tendered yield was 7.26 percent, it said.
The notes carry a coupon of 7.32 percent and mature on September 17, 2001. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843-6441
